declarations.bibleVerseText: Anyone who wants to be first must be the very last, and the servant of all.

declarations.text: How you treat the forgotten is how you treat Jesus. Don't skip the small ones.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever welcomes one of these little children in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me does not welcome me but the one who sent me.

declarations.text: What holds you back from God is not worth keeping. Cut it. Freedom costs something.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life maimed than with two hands to go into hell.

declarations.text: Fire burns away what is false. Don't run from the process. Let God purify what remains.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everyone will be salted with fire. Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can you make it salty again?

declarations.text: You carry salt. Use it. Preserve truth. Bring peace. Salt that sits does nothing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with each other.

declarations.text: Lay hands on the sick. That is your assignment. Not a suggestion. A sign that follows believers.
declarations.bibleVerseText: They will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well.

declarations.text: The kingdom of God is inside you. You don't wait for it to arrive. You release it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The kingdom of God is in your midst.

declarations.text: Stand for Jesus now. Don't shrink. The world needs what you carry.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If anyone is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his Father's glory with the holy angels.

declarations.text: Old patterns can't hold what God is pouring. Become new. Or you will miss it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins.

declarations.text: What looks impossible to you is ordinary to God. Stop limiting Him with your logic.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With man this is impossible, but not with God; all things are possible with God.

declarations.text: Jesus spoke to the storm. Not around it. Not about it. To it. So can you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, 'Quiet! Be still!' Then the wind died down and it was completely calm.

declarations.text: God blesses beyond what you can measure. His favor overflows. Get ready to contain it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the child you will bear!

declarations.text: God's mercy doesn't stop with you. It runs through you into your children. Fear God. Pass it on.
declarations.bibleVerseText: His mercy extends to those who fear him, from generation to generation.

declarations.text: Hungry people get filled. Full people go empty. Stay hungry for God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He has filled the hungry with good things but has sent the rich away empty.

declarations.text: Salvation doesn't stop at you. It moves through your whole house. Believe for everyone under your roof.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Jesus said to him, 'Today salvation has come to this house, because this man, too, is a son of Abraham.'

declarations.text: Jesus came to find the lost. Now you go. You are the plan.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.

declarations.text: Jesus has authority to forgive ALL your sin. Not some. All. Walk in that freedom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.

declarations.text: You are anointed. Not for comfort. For mission. Go tell the poor their situation can change.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor.

declarations.text: You carry freedom in your mouth. Declare it. Captives get free when you speak.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners and recovery of sight for the blind, to set the oppressed free.

declarations.text: This is your year of favor. Not next year. Not when you get your act together. NOW.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners and recovery of sight for the blind, to set the oppressed free, to proclaim the year of the Lord's favor.

declarations.text: God's word is not future tense for you. It is being fulfilled today. In your hearing. Right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He began by saying to them, 'Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.'

declarations.text: When people reject you for Jesus, heaven takes notice. Your reward is great. Don't quit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are you when people hate you, when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil, because of the Son of Man.

declarations.text: Faithful in little. Trusted with much. Your consistency is building something eternal.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven.

declarations.text: Give without expecting back. That is the kingdom economy. Your reward comes from God, not people.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them without expecting to get anything back. Then your reward will be great.

declarations.text: No word from God fails. Not one. What He promised in your life is still on the way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For no word from God will ever fail.

declarations.text: The power of the Most High covers you. You are not exposed. You are overshadowed by God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you.

declarations.text: Let your whole being praise God. Not because life is easy. Because God is great.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My soul glorifies the Lord and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior.

declarations.text: God has done great things for you. Tell it. Don't stay quiet about what He has done.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Mighty One has done great things for me holy is his name.

declarations.text: Belief activates the promise. You don't get it first and then believe. You believe first.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord would fulfill his promises to her!

declarations.text: Give and it comes back. Pressed down. Shaken together. Running over. But you go first.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap.

declarations.text: God gave you authority over ALL the power of the enemy. Use it. Nothing can harm you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy; nothing will harm you.

declarations.text: Your name is written in heaven. That is worth more than any title on earth. Celebrate that.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Rejoice that your names are written in heaven.

declarations.text: The kingdom is already inside you. Stop waiting for it to show up. Release it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The kingdom of God is in your midst.

declarations.text: Faithfulness with little opens the door to much. Don't despise small assignments.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever is faithful in very little is also faithful in much.

declarations.text: God is glorified when you bear MUCH fruit. Not a little. Much. Go produce.
declarations.bibleVerseText: This is to my Father's glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.

declarations.text: Your Father is pleased to give you the kingdom. Stop being afraid. The kingdom is yours.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom.

declarations.text: Your new birth is not from man. It is from God. That changes everything about who you are.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband's will, but born of God.

declarations.text: Jesus came full of grace and truth. You get both. Not one without the other.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.

declarations.text: God's grace does not run out. You get grace on top of grace. His supply never empties.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.

declarations.text: True worship is not performance. It is Spirit and truth. Anything less is just noise.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Yet a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in the Spirit and in truth.

declarations.text: Doing God's will feeds you at a level food never can. Get full on obedience.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But he said to them, 'I have food to eat that you know nothing about.' Then his disciples said to each other, 'Could someone have brought him food?' 'My food,' said Jesus, 'is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.'

declarations.text: Your deepest hunger is for purpose, not pleasure. Do God's will. That is where you get fed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.

declarations.text: You heard. You believed. You crossed from death to life. No condemnation. No second-guessing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Very truly I tell you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be judged but has crossed over from death to life.

declarations.text: Jesus is the only thing that truly satisfies. Everything else leaves you empty. Come to Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then Jesus declared, 'I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.'

declarations.text: Follow Jesus and darkness cannot hold you. You don't navigate in the dark. You walk in the light.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, 'I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.'

declarations.text: Jesus said I AM before time began. He was there then. He is here now. He is enough.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Very truly I tell you, Jesus answered, before Abraham was born, I am!

declarations.text: Jesus is the only door to abundant life. Go through Him. There is no other way in.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore Jesus said again, 'Very truly I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.'

declarations.text: Jesus laid down His life for you. You were worth dying for. Don't live like you are worthless.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

declarations.text: Death does not get the final word over you. Jesus is the resurrection. Believe it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Jesus said to her, 'I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die.'

declarations.text: Ask in Jesus' name. Not your name. His. And watch God move.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

declarations.text: The Holy Spirit teaches you all things. You are never without wisdom. Ask. He answers.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things.

declarations.text: Stay connected to Jesus and fruit comes naturally. Cut off from the vine, you produce nothing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit.

declarations.text: Jesus gave you His joy. Not temporary happiness. Complete, lasting joy. Walk in it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.

declarations.text: Jesus calls you friend, not servant. Friends know things servants don't. He trusts you with His heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master's business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.

declarations.text: Trouble is guaranteed. But Jesus already won. You fight from victory, not toward it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.

declarations.text: God loved you enough to give His Son. That is not small love. Don't take it lightly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

declarations.text: Your spirit was born from God's Spirit. You are not just flesh. You carry eternal origin.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit.

declarations.text: The truth does not comfort you into freedom. It confronts you into it. Know it. Live it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Jesus said, 'If you hold to my teaching, you are really my disciples. Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.'

declarations.text: Jesus came so you could have life FULL. Not half. Not survival. Full and overflowing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.

declarations.text: You are not a pond. You are a river. Living water is supposed to flow through you to others.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever believes in me, as Scripture has said, rivers of living water will flow from within them.

declarations.text: Believe and you do the works Jesus did. Even greater ones. Stop settling for less.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Very truly I tell you, whoever believes in me will do the works I have been doing, and they will do even greater things.

declarations.text: Whatever you ask in His name, He does it. So that God gets the glory. Ask boldly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

declarations.text: The Spirit teaches you everything. You are not left to figure it out alone. Ask. He guides.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things.

declarations.text: Apart from Jesus you produce nothing. In Him you bear much fruit. Stay connected.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit.

declarations.text: Your joy is not based on your situation. Jesus put His joy in you. It is already there.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.

declarations.text: You are not a servant who follows orders. You are a friend who knows the plan.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master's business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.

declarations.text: Jesus has overcome the world. That means your problem is already defeated. Take heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.

declarations.text: You did not earn your righteousness. God gave it free. Stop trying to pay for what is already purchased.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And all are justified freely by his grace through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: Your suffering is not a detour. It is the road. Perseverance comes through pressure, not around it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Not only so, but we also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance.

declarations.text: God's love is already inside you. The Spirit put it there. You don't find it. You release it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And hope does not put us to shame, because God's love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit.

declarations.text: Where sin went up, grace went higher. Your worst moment did not out-run God's grace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But where sin increased, grace increased all the more.

declarations.text: Sin is dead to you. You are alive to God. Count it as true and live like it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In the same way, count yourselves dead to sin but alive to God in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: Sin is not your master. Grace is your new address. Stop living under the old rules.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For sin shall no longer be your master, because you are not under the law, but under grace.

declarations.text: You were set free from sin to belong to God. That is not bondage. That is where you thrive.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves of God, the benefit you reap leads to holiness, and the result is eternal life.

declarations.text: No condemnation. None. Zero. Stop carrying what God has already removed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: When you don't know what to pray, the Spirit prays for you. You are never alone in the room.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. We do not know what we ought to pray for, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us through wordless groans.

declarations.text: Jesus is at God's right hand right now. Speaking for you. You have the best advocate there is.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who then is the one who condemns? No one. Christ Jesus who died more than that, who was raised to life is at the right hand of God and is also interceding for us.

declarations.text: God knew you before you were born. He planned for you to look like Jesus. That is still the plan.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For those God foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers and sisters.

declarations.text: If God is for you, it doesn't matter who is against you. Do the math.
declarations.bibleVerseText: What, then, shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

declarations.text: God gave you His Son. He will not hold back anything else. What He did then covers what you need now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He who did not spare his own Son, but gave him up for us all how will he not also, along with him, graciously give us all things?

declarations.text: Your feet are beautiful. Not because they look good. Because they carry good news.
declarations.bibleVerseText: How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!

declarations.text: Stop letting the world shape you. Let God renew your mind. What you think determines what you become.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

declarations.text: The gospel is power. Not just good news. POWER. Don't be ashamed of what saves people.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God that brings salvation to everyone who believes.

declarations.text: Faith in Jesus gives you peace with God. Not peace after you try harder. Peace now. Through Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: ALL things work for your good. Not some. All. Even the painful ones. Trust the process.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

declarations.text: You are not just surviving. You are MORE than a conqueror. That is who God says you are.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

declarations.text: Nothing in all creation can cut you off from God's love. Not death. Not failure. Nothing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers, neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

declarations.text: Give your body to God as a living offering. Not your leftover time. Your life. All of it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God's mercy, to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice.

declarations.text: Transformation starts in your mind. Renew it daily. What you think in private shows up in your life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

declarations.text: Faith comes from hearing. Not hoping. Not wishing. Hearing the Word. Keep listening.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Consequently, faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word about Christ.

declarations.text: Call on Jesus and you are saved. Not maybe. Not possibly. Every single person who calls.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For, 'Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.'

declarations.text: God's wisdom was hidden until now. He destined it for your glory. Speak it like you know it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No, we declare God's wisdom, a mystery that has been hidden and that God destined for our glory before time began.

declarations.text: The Spirit inside you searches the deep things of God. You have access to the Almighty's mind.
declarations.bibleVerseText: These are the things God has revealed to us by his Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.

declarations.text: You are enriched in every way in Christ. Not someday. Now. Stop acting like you are lacking.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For in him you have been enriched in every way with all kinds of speech and with all knowledge.

declarations.text: You plant. You water. But God gives the growth. Trust the process. Don't quit before harvest.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I planted the seed, Apollos watered it, but God has been making it grow.

declarations.text: Build with gold and it survives the fire. Build with wood and it burns. What are you building with?
declarations.bibleVerseText: If anyone builds on this foundation using gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay or straw, their work will be shown for what it is.

declarations.text: Your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit. Not a trash can. Not a playground. A temple.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God?

declarations.text: You were bought at a price. The highest price ever paid. Live like you know what you cost.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are not your own; you were bought at a price. Therefore honor God with your bodies.

declarations.text: Your gift is unique. The Spirit chose it for you specifically. Stop comparing yours to someone else's.
declarations.bibleVerseText: There are different kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit distributes them.

declarations.text: You are part of the body of Christ. Not optional. Not extra. Required. They need what you carry.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Just as a body, though one, has many parts, but all its many parts form one body, so it is with Christ.

declarations.text: Gifts without love are just noise. The most excellent way is not a feeling. It is a choice. Choose love.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And yet I will show you the most excellent way.

declarations.text: No love and your gifts are just noise. Love is the thing. Without it, nothing else matters.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If I speak in the tongues of men or of angels, but do not have love, I am only a resounding gong or a clanging cymbal.

declarations.text: Love does not quit. It protects. It trusts. It hopes. It endures. That is your assignment.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.

declarations.text: Now you see in part. One day you see fully. Keep growing. The best view is still ahead.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For now we see only a reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.

declarations.text: Faith, hope, and love all last. But love is the greatest. Lead with it and never lose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.

declarations.text: Your mortal body puts on immortality. Death is not your end. It is your transition.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the perishable must clothe itself with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.

declarations.text: God gives you the victory. You did not earn it. You cannot lose it. It is already yours.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: Stand firm. Let nothing move you. Your work for God is never wasted. Never.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, my dear brothers and sisters, stand firm. Let nothing move you. Always give yourselves fully to the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

declarations.text: More suffering means more comfort. God scales His comfort to match every pain you carry.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For just as we share abundantly in the sufferings of Christ, so also our comfort abounds through Christ.

declarations.text: God is the one who makes you stand. He anointed you. He sealed you. He guaranteed your future.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now it is God who makes both us and you stand firm in Christ. He anointed us, set his seal of ownership on us, and put his Spirit in our hearts as a deposit, guaranteeing what is to come.

declarations.text: You are a letter written by Jesus. People read you before they read the Bible. What does your life say?
declarations.bibleVerseText: You show that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God.

declarations.text: Where the Spirit is, freedom is. You carry Him. That means you carry freedom wherever you go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

declarations.text: Look at Jesus and you become like Him. That is how transformation works. Eyes on Him. Not the mirror.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And we all, who with unveiled faces contemplate the Lord's glory, are being transformed into his image with ever-increasing glory.

declarations.text: You are an ordinary jar. But the treasure inside you is extraordinary. The power is from God. That is the point.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this all-surpassing power is from God and not from us.

declarations.text: Pressed but not crushed. Confused but not destroyed. You are still standing. That is not luck. That is God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We are hard pressed on every side, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair.

declarations.text: Your outside may be wearing down. Your inside is being renewed every single day. Do not lose heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though outwardly we are wasting away, yet inwardly we are being renewed day by day.

declarations.text: What you see is temporary. What you can't see is eternal. Fix your eyes on the right thing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen, since what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.

declarations.text: This body is a tent. Your real home is being built in heaven. Don't be too attached to the tent.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is destroyed, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.

declarations.text: Absent from the body means present with God. Death is not a loss. It is arrival.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We are confident, I say, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.

declarations.text: One day you stand before Christ and give account. Live today with that day in mind.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each of us may receive what is due us for the things done while in the body, whether good or bad.

declarations.text: The love of Christ pushes you. Not rules. Not fear. Love. Let it move you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For Christ's love compels us, because we are convinced that one died for all, and therefore all died.

declarations.text: Stop seeing people through the world's eyes. Jesus changes everything. See them through the Spirit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So from now on we regard no one from a worldly point of view. Though we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.

declarations.text: God reconciled you. Now He gave you that same ministry. You carry the message that changes everything.
declarations.bibleVerseText: All this is from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation.

declarations.text: Now is the time. Not later. Not when you feel ready. God's favor is available right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I tell you, now is the time of God's favor, now is the day of salvation.

declarations.text: Your life is your message. Don't let how you live cancel what you say. Integrity is non-negotiable.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We put no stumbling block in anyone's path, so that our ministry will not be discredited.

declarations.text: You cannot please people and serve God at the same time. Pick one. One of them lasts.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ.

declarations.text: Your gospel is not man-made. It came by revelation. Don't let anyone talk you out of what God showed you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that the gospel I preached is not of human origin. I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: You don't live by what you see. You live by faith in the Son of God. That is a different level.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.

declarations.text: The law led you to Christ. But Christ is here now. You are not under the guardian anymore.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So the law was our guardian until Christ came that we might be justified by faith.

declarations.text: Faith is here. The schoolmaster is done. You are not a student waiting for approval. You are a son.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now that this faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian.

declarations.text: Faith in Jesus makes you God's child. Not good behavior. Not religious effort. Faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So in Christ Jesus you are all children of God through faith.

declarations.text: You put on Christ. Not your past. Not your failures. Christ. That is what people see.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.

declarations.text: In Christ, every dividing wall is gone. You belong to one family. One Father. One inheritance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: You belong to Christ. That makes you Abraham's heir. The promise is yours. Stop acting like an outsider.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.

declarations.text: God's timing is perfect. He sent Jesus at exactly the right moment. He is doing the same in your life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But when the set time had fully come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law, to redeem those under the law, that we might receive adoption to sonship.

declarations.text: God sent the Spirit of His Son into your heart. You cry Abba. That is son talk. Not servant talk.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Because you are his sons, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, the Spirit who calls out, 'Abba, Father.'

declarations.text: You are not a slave anymore. You are a son. Sons and slaves don't act the same. Know the difference.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So you are no longer a slave, but God's child; and since you are his child, God has made you also an heir.

declarations.text: Your real home is above. You were born free. Don't let anyone put you back in chains.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, and she is our mother.

declarations.text: You are a child of promise. Not an accident. Not a plan B. Born from the Spirit, not the flesh.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now you, brothers and sisters, like Isaac, are children of promise.

declarations.text: The Spirit leads you. The law can't hold you. Follow the Spirit and walk free.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

declarations.text: You live by the Spirit. So keep in step with the Spirit. Don't fall behind. Don't run ahead. Stay close.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Since we live by the Spirit, let us keep in step with the Spirit.

declarations.text: You bear the marks of Jesus. That silences every accusation. You belong to Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: From now on, let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.

declarations.text: Do good now. Don't wait for a better opportunity. The opportunity is right in front of you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all people, especially to those who belong to the family of believers.

declarations.text: Don't quit doing good. The harvest is real. But it only comes to those who don't give up.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

declarations.text: You reap what you sow. Every time. God is not mocked. Sow carefully. Harvest accordingly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be deceived: God cannot be mocked. A man reaps what he sows.

declarations.text: Christ set you free for freedom. Not freedom to do wrong. Freedom to live right. Stand firm. Stay free.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not let yourselves be burdened again by a yoke of slavery.

declarations.text: Walk by the Spirit daily. The flesh loses its grip when the Spirit leads. Stay sensitive. Stay yielded.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

declarations.text: The Spirit's fruit grows in you naturally. But only if you stay connected. Dead branches don't fruit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, forbearance, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.

declarations.text: You died with Christ. Your old self is gone. Now Christ lives in you. Let Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me.

declarations.text: Sow to the flesh and reap destruction. Sow to the Spirit and reap eternal life. You choose every day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever sows to please their flesh will reap destruction; whoever sows to please the Spirit will reap eternal life.

declarations.text: God chose you on purpose. Before you did anything right. Before you did anything wrong. On purpose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we know, brothers and sisters loved by God, that he has chosen you.

declarations.text: Rejoice always. Pray without stopping. Give thanks in everything. That is God's will for your life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: God sanctifies your whole self. Spirit. Soul. Body. Nothing is left out. He goes all the way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May God himself, the God of peace, sanctify you through and through.

declarations.text: You are not in the dark. You are a child of light. Light people don't get ambushed by darkness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness so that this day should surprise you like a thief. You are all children of the light and children of the day. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

declarations.text: Jesus is coming back. That is not a maybe. It is a certainty. Live every day with that in mind.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the Lord himself will come down from heaven, with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet call of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.

declarations.text: God is faithful. He strengthens you. He guards you from the enemy. You don't stand alone.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.

declarations.text: Stand firm. Hold fast. Don't let every new wind move you. Know what you believe and stay there.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the teachings we passed on to you, whether by word of mouth or by letter.

declarations.text: God encourages your heart. He strengthens you in every good word and work. You are not doing this alone.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by his grace gave us eternal encouragement and good hope, encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good deed and word.

declarations.text: Let God direct your heart into His love. Into Christ's perseverance. That is where the strength comes from.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the Lord direct your hearts into God's love and Christ's perseverance.

declarations.text: Grace and peace are yours. Not from the world. From God Himself. Receive them both today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: Your own understanding has limits. God's does not. Trust Him with your whole heart and stop leaning on what you think you know.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.

declarations.text: You can plan your way or submit your way. Only one leads somewhere. Give God control and He will make your path straight.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.

declarations.text: Silver can be lost. Gold can be stolen. Wisdom builds wealth no one can take from you. Seek it above everything else.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who find wisdom, those who gain understanding, for she is more profitable than silver and yields better returns than gold.

declarations.text: You can make your plans. God will determine your steps. Stop fighting His direction and let Him establish your path.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

declarations.text: What you let into your heart will come out in your life. Guard it above all else. Everything flows from it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

declarations.text: Your path does not stay dim. Walk right and it gets brighter. Every day builds on the last. Keep going.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The path of the righteous is like the morning sun, shining ever brighter till the full light of day.

declarations.text: Your plans without God are just wishes. Commit your work to Him and He will make them stand.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

declarations.text: Your words either turn away anger or stir it up. A soft answer is not weakness. It is wisdom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

declarations.text: Honor God and your days are added to. Ignore Him and they are cut short. That is not a threat. It is a law.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The fear of the Lord adds length to life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.

declarations.text: Nothing you could ever want compares to wisdom. Not money. Not status. Not comfort. Seek it and you will have more than you imagined.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.

declarations.text: Wise lips spread knowledge. Foolish hearts spread nothing. What comes out of your mouth reveals what is in your heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but the hearts of fools are not upright.

declarations.text: Iron sharpens iron. Who you surround yourself with will either sharpen you or soften you. Choose your circle on purpose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.

declarations.text: You can make 100 plans. Only God's purpose will stand. Stop fighting His will. Align with it and watch things move.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Many are the plans in a person's heart, but it is the Lord's purpose that prevails.

declarations.text: Your reputation outlasts your bank account. A good name is worth more than silver or gold. Build it on purpose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold.

declarations.text: Lazy hands make for poverty. Diligent hands bring wealth. You cannot pray your way out of what you must work your way through.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Lazy hands make for poverty, but diligent hands bring wealth.

declarations.text: The blessing of God brings wealth without painful toil. Stop working harder in your own strength. Start walking in His blessing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.

declarations.text: Your words carry the power of life and death. You will eat the fruit of what you say. Speak life every single day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

declarations.text: Your character is either a crown or decay to those closest to you. Choose noble character. Build your home up.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A wife of noble character is her husband's crown, but a disgraceful wife is like decay in his bones.

declarations.text: Strength and dignity are your clothing. When you wear them, you can laugh at what comes next. Fear has no power over a prepared person.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She is clothed with strength and dignity; she can laugh at the days to come.

declarations.text: The people closest to you should be your greatest testimony. Live so well that your family calls you blessed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Her children arise and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her.

declarations.text: Wisdom is more profitable than silver. Understanding yields better returns than gold. Stop chasing money. Chase wisdom and it will bring you both.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who find wisdom, those who gain understanding, for she is more profitable than silver.

declarations.text: Integrity does not just feel good. It protects you. Righteousness guards your path. Wickedness destroys from the inside out.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Righteousness guards the person of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

declarations.text: Wisdom builds the house. Understanding makes it stand. Knowledge fills it with treasure. You do not build a great life by accident.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By wisdom a house is built, and through understanding it is established; through knowledge its rooms are filled with rare and beautiful treasures.

declarations.text: What you plant in your children today will grow for decades. Start them right. It will last longer than you will.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.

declarations.text: Pride does not build you up. It brings you down. A haughty spirit comes before a fall. Stay humble and stay standing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall. Better to be lowly in spirit along with the oppressed than to share plunder with the proud.
